brief: A cabinet of three cells with two drawers, one of them shown pulled open.

requirements.evidence: 3 pieces: piece:0,0,0;half-s at 0,0,0, piece:0,1,0;half-n at 0,1,0 and piece:1,1,0;full at 1,1,0 form an L-shaped cabinet of three hex cells; connector locks the shared edge.
drawer:0#0,0#cut at 0,0,0 stem n and drawer:0#0,1#cut at 0,1,0 stem s – two drawer units installed on the half-base cut faces.
setDrawerOpen at 0,0,0 open=true succeeded; other drawer remains closed (meshClash clear).

finish.summary: Three-cell L cabinet built from two half bases (0,0 half-s, 0,1 half-n) plus one full base (1,1). Two drawers installed on the half-base cut faces; one drawer at 0,0 opened via setDrawerOpen. Configuration validates with meshClash clear and only informational OPEN_CAP_FACE remaining.

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
